recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It aligns the authoritative element definition with existing narrative guidance and later SubscriptionStatus decisions without reintroducing removed fields or changing the intentional query-status naming.
issue_request: FHIR-27129 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-I request to move Subscription.error to SubscriptionStatus.error, rename SubscriptionStatus.notificationType to type, add status-query/query status behavior, and clarify event count descriptions for non-event notifications.
initial_application: FHIR#27129 commits in 2020 already moved Subscription.error to SubscriptionStatus.error, renamed notificationType to type, intentionally chose query-status terminology, and added query-status documentation/examples. The remaining gap was the stale eventsSinceSubscriptionStart element definition.
additional_context: Subscription and SubscriptionStatus are active current-build resources. FHIR-27130 approved Subscription/$status for dynamic status checks in the same tracker block; later changes removed eventsInNotification, added query-event and constraints, and linked $status to query-status guidance.
reconciliation: Updated source/subscriptionstatus/structuredefinition-SubscriptionStatus.xml to say event-notification counts are inclusive of the current notification and that handshake, heartbeat, query-status, and query-event notifications do not increment the count.
source_changes: source/subscriptionstatus/structuredefinition-SubscriptionStatus.xml: clarified SubscriptionStatus.eventsSinceSubscriptionStart increment semantics across event-notification, handshake, heartbeat, query-status, and query-event notification types.

related_jiras.note: Approved Subscription/$status in the same FHIR-I meeting to support dynamic client status checks.
Clarified that eventsSinceSubscriptionStart is inclusive of the current event notification.
Removed SubscriptionStatus.eventsInNotification and refined notification event guidance, so reconciliation must not restore that element.
Added SubscriptionStatus constraints that retain query-status behavior.
Linked Subscription/$status return documentation to query-status guidance, confirming current terminology.
